photographs.source_path: Phtotgraphy sphere assets/Youthful exuberance/SCENE 1_THE ALBUM COVER.png
photographs.caption: The cover image for a nine-scene monochrome study of gesture, proximity, and shared space.
Two faces approach across a narrow interval; the bright negative space between them becomes part of the composition.
Two figures face one another with mirrored hand gestures, turning the space between them into a visual exchange.
Raised fingers form an improvised frame around a partially concealed gaze.
A frontal portrait uses symmetrical hand placement to create a playful graphic interruption across the face.
One figure places a hand on the other's head as the two lean toward one another, creating a close, trusting gesture.
The two figures turn in opposing directions, creating a back-to-back arrangement and a clear division of attention.
Two turned profiles and raised arms create a vertical counterpoint against the open background.
A close two-person portrait is layered by an arm crossing the foreground, connecting the figures within one frame.
